environment_source: BRIDGE v1.1.1 published sticky-action 25% MDPs; group-generated offline logs and learner labels
state: BFS-reachable (base_state, previous_executed_action), terminal absorbing; reset sentinel
reward: Divide raw public MDP rewards by each task's positive published maximum; no shift; same normalized-return endpoint
pilot: Independent x10*S*A transition stream per behavior; fixed hash-derived seed; generated before labels
label_training: Independent x50*S*A natural streams with nested x1,x2,x5,x10,x20,x50 prefixes, ten seeds, BC/CFQI/IQL; 8/10 sustained suffix
comparison_rule: Same task-behavior-learner rows, no new tuning from these labels; original published scores rank against E_l only and do not output its seven-class law
seal_gate: All 75 predictions per forecaster and 25 original scalar-score rows must be hashed before any learner label run
limits: Follow-up panel selected after the earlier five-task result, using only prior-use status, published size and reward-domain metadata.
The 155-MDP author benchmark evaluates online SQIRL/PPO/DQN/GORP and effective horizon, a different endpoint from offline learner requirement.
Published MDPs are third-party; the offline trajectories and learner labels are generated by this project.
An infeasible prelabel resource gate is recorded as NO-GO, never replaced by post-outcome task selection.
No method retuning after any new learner labels are opened.
panel_name: BRIDGE expanded prospective follow-up, five new MDPs
